full_prompt_en: The square image is a clean digital concept illustration of an armored humanoid figure against a pale grey-white background. The figure is shown from the upper torso upward, turned in a three-quarter view toward the left side of the frame. Its helmet has a rounded white and charcoal shell with two large turquoise-green compound eye panels; the nearer panel dominates the front, while part of the second panel remains visible around the far side. Two long, thin antennae rise from the crown and diverge into an elongated V shape, one extending beyond the top edge. A dark lower faceplate and layered jaw guard cover the area beneath the eye panels, with small bolts and seams marking the assembly. The neck is black and segmented, connecting the helmet to broad white-grey shoulder plates. Across the chest, a central white plate carries a vivid red stripe and a narrower turquoise-green stripe, with a small rectangular green inset near the middle. The shoulder and upper arm forms are asymmetrical in the crop, with rounded white armor, black joint gaps and a few red-orange markings. A dark circular fitting appears near the lower-left edge of the torso, partly cut off by the frame. The material reads as smooth painted metal or hard plastic, with cool grey shading and crisp reflected highlights along raised edges. Small panel lines, fasteners and scratches give the surface a manufactured, handled quality without cluttering its broad shapes. The background stays nearly blank, with a faint cool grey gradient and no visible environment. Light is broad and even from the front-left, brightening the white armor and leaving the far side of the helmet and neck in softer shadow. The turquoise eye panels hold the strongest colour area, balanced by the angular red and green chest stripes. The lower edge crops through the torso, so neither the hands nor the figure’s full stance is visible. A pale shoulder shell overlaps a darker inner section, and a small round fastener sits near the outer edge of the arm plate. The chest stripes turn across the upper plate and descend toward the cropped waist, giving the otherwise pale torso a clear directional accent. Fine grey panel boundaries separate helmet sections with a red graphic emblem visible on the nearer shoulder plate. The overall composition is a precise, slightly off-centre product-like portrait, combining a pale neutral ground, clear mechanical layering and a restrained palette of white, charcoal, red and turquoise.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的清爽数字概念插画，浅灰白背景前是一名装甲人形角色。画面取景至上半身，角色以斜侧面朝向画面左侧。头盔由圆润的白色与炭灰色外壳构成，带有两块大型青绿色复眼面板；近侧面板占据前方显眼位置，远侧面板则有一部分从头盔另一侧露出。两根细长天线从头顶升起，分向两侧形成细长的V形，其中一根延伸到画框上缘之外。深色下脸甲与分层下颌护板覆盖复眼面板下方，可见小螺栓和接缝标记各部件的拼装关系。黑色分节颈部连接头盔与宽阔的白灰色肩甲。胸前中央是一块白色护板，上面有醒目的红色条带和较窄的青绿色条带，中间附近还嵌着一块小长方形绿色部件。由于画面裁切，肩部与上臂形体并不对称：圆润白色装甲、黑色关节缝隙和少量红橙色标记交替出现。躯干左下边缘露出一处深色圆形接合部，部分被画框截断。材料看起来像平滑涂装金属或硬质塑料，凸起边缘带有冷灰阴影与清晰反光。细小面板线、紧固件和划痕赋予表面制造与使用痕迹，但不破坏宽阔形体的简洁感。背景几乎空白，只带淡淡冷灰渐变，看不到具体环境。光线从左前方宽泛、均匀地照来，使白色装甲变亮，而头盔远侧与颈部落入柔和阴影。青绿色复眼面板是最强烈的色块，与胸前带转折的红绿条带形成平衡。画面下缘从躯干处截断，因此看不到双手或完整站姿。浅色肩甲覆盖在较深的内层结构之上，臂甲外缘附近有一枚小圆形紧固件。胸前条带从上方护板转折向下，延伸至被裁切的腰部附近，为浅色躯干提供清晰的方向性强调。细灰色面板边界分隔头盔各部分，近侧肩甲上可见红色图形徽记。整体构图像一幅精确且略偏心的产品式肖像，把浅色中性背景、清楚的机械层叠关系与白、炭灰、红、青绿的克制配色结合起来。
style_prompt_en: The concept illustration uses crisp, controlled edges and layered geometric construction. Broad light surfaces contrast with charcoal recesses, while saturated accent colours appear in narrow, carefully placed bands. Highlights follow raised contours and material changes, helping separate overlapping planes without heavy outlines. Fine seams and small marks add precision, but the main shapes remain clean and legible. The neutral background stays quiet so the limited accent palette carries visual weight. The overall treatment is polished and graphic, balancing smooth gradients, hard-surface detail and a clear silhouette against generous open space.
style_prompt_zh: 概念插画采用清晰而受控的边缘和层层组合的几何结构。宽阔的浅色表面与炭黑凹部形成对照，饱和强调色则以窄条形式谨慎布置。高光沿凸起轮廓和材质转换处延伸，使相互叠压的平面彼此分开，却不依赖粗重描边。细缝与小痕迹增加精确感，主要形体仍保持干净易读。中性背景安静退后，让有限的强调色承担视觉重量。整体处理精致而图形化，在平滑渐变、硬质表面细节和清楚轮廓之间取得平衡，并保留充足留白。
theme_en: White-armored masked figure with turquoise compound eyes
theme_zh: 青绿复眼与白色装甲的蒙面人形角色
name: Kamen Rider
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
